scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of exact monoid normal forms, finite-discrete proximal relation, sharp state/generator lower bounds; finite Python checks are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: A specific two-generator finite family, not a classification of all semigroup actions.
The nonbijective system has no common invariant probability; the invariant-probability question from the motivating paper is not addressed.
The pair-synchronization/kernel-graph interpretation is known prior work; priority for this explicit realization requires independent literature verification.
title: Sharp four-state obstruction and even-cycle spectra for finite semigroup regional proximality
